recentItems.title: Prime minister's investment summit 'breathtakingly audacious': former ambassador | Power & Politics
recentItems.description:

Plus, International Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu tells P&P the summit will draw significant investment and lead to 'a lot of projects being built in Canada.'

recentItems.title: 20 years later, ceremony held to honour survivors, victim of Dawson College shooting
recentItems.description:
